goal: Add the lane-independent content-freshness gate at the persist boundary (ADR 0017): under the review FOR UPDATE lock persistResponseAndNotify already takes first, re-read review_content_hash and skip the responses INSERT when it and loadedReviewContentHash are both non-null and differ, completing the job with a queryable skip reason.
non_goals: No change to evaluateAutoApprovalCandidate — it stays byte-identical (D-H, invariant #3); its hash gate remains defense in depth
No schema change, no migration (map #710 rules them out; none needed at the persist boundary)
No lane branch — the gate runs before the lane split, unconditionally
No persisting the stale draft in any status (failed/superseded) — starves the colliding fresh job via the (review_id, version) idempotency check
No fix for the residual legacy edit-draft lane (REGENERATE over a posted sibling, EDIT_REPLIES_ENABLED off in prod) — accepted in ADR 0017, revisit with #726/#727 territory
No spine step, audit row, or any other DB write on the skip path
user_visible_behavior: A draft generated against review text the customer changed mid-generation is never persisted: no pending_approval row, no owner notification for the stale text — the colliding fresh job's draft (current content) is what the owner sees
The skipped job completes (not fails) with skip reason stale_review_content queryable on the job_outbox row
A structured log line records every gate fire with review_id, business_id, version, and origin_lane
invariants: evaluateAutoApprovalCandidate byte-identical; auto-approval chain neither duplicated nor touched (D-H, invariant #3)
Gate skip performs ZERO DB writes in the persist tx — the (review_id, version) slot stays free for the colliding fresh job
A null hash on EITHER side passes the gate (freshness check, not provenance proof; legacy pre-hash reviews keep generating)
The review FOR UPDATE remains the persist transaction's FIRST statement; the hash re-read rides that same statement, so no statement precedes the lock
Gate runs before the lane split and covers on_demand_generate, regenerate, backfill, and both live-ingest lanes
Invariant #4 moderation-hold path unchanged for persisted drafts
Orphan-review lock no-op keeps its existing Sentry-warn-and-proceed posture; unknown current hash passes the gate
edge_cases: Fresh worker persisted first at the shared version: stale worker's gate fires on the hash mismatch and skips cleanly instead of surfacing a unique violation
Stale worker persists BEFORE the content change commits: no mismatch at persist time; live-ingest's committed-draft repair (review_content_changed + version+1 enqueue) covers it — out of gate scope
Legacy edit-draft residual: gate skip with no replacement job; review_edited_after_post exception + admin notification already cover it (accepted)
loadedReviewContentHash null (legacy pre-hash review) → pass; current hash null → pass; both null → pass; equal → pass
Crash between the gate-skip tx and outbox completion: BullMQ retry re-runs the gate idempotently
existing_patterns_to_follow: OUTBOX_COMPLETION_REASON vocabulary — the single owner of every job_outbox.completion_reason value (src/lib/shared/outbox-completion-reason.ts); the skip token joins it as STALE_REVIEW_CONTENT
loadGenerationContext 'skipped' outcome -> handler logs structured reason + completes outbox (worker/jobs/ResponseGeneratorWorker.ts:46-52)
auto-approval-daily-cap.integration.test.ts live-DB suite shape: describeWithDb, seedTenantAccount, two postgres clients for genuine concurrency, production statement order mirrored
tests_to_add: persist gate skips the INSERT when review content changed after load (stale-content direction)
persist gate leaves the (review_id, version) slot free for the colliding fresh job
skips persist and returns skipped_stale_content when loaded and current hashes are both non-null and differ
gate skip performs no writes: no responses INSERT, no api_costs link, no spine steps, no notification enqueue
persists when loaded hash is null (legacy pre-hash review passes the gate)
persists when current hash is null
completes the outbox with stale_review_content and skips first_response_drafted on a gate skip
content-freshness gate skips iff both hashes are non-null and differ
persist gate re-reads review_content_hash under the review FOR UPDATE lock (blocks on a concurrent content-change tx, then skips)
content-freshness gate skips every generate-response origin lane before lane-specific work
gate skip logs stale_review_content with review_id, business_id, version, and origin_lane without raw hashes
rollback_plan: No migration — pure worker-code change. Back out by reverting the PR on main and fast-forwarding staging; no data cleanup needed (the gate only ever refrains from inserting). db_touching is set for the live-DB test provisioning + tenant-scope/rls audits, not for schema change.
observability: Structured log line on every gate fire (queryable reason field stale_review_content, plus review_id, business_id, version, origin_lane) — ADR 0017's designated signal
job_outbox completion reason stale_review_content via markOutboxCompletedWithReason — ops can count gate fires with a single-token query
